store_costs_8q.csvHere's our store-level cost data for the last 8 quarters. Don't just summarize it. Tell me where costs are growing fastest relative to sales.

Food cost is climbing fastest as a share of revenue. Labor and rent are basically flat. Want me to break it down by region?

What are the most relevant questions I should be asking of this data to find where the margin is slipping?

Good instinct. Here's where I'd dig:

  • 1Each cost as a % of revenue, not raw dollars.
  • 2Break it down by region.
  • 3Compare to the same period last year.
  • 4Separate price increases from waste.
Now build me a chart comparing food cost, labor, and rent as a percent of sales.

Here it is. Food cost is the only line moving.
